correctness.rationale: For every h>0, the sixteen-edge list and exact dot-product signs produce a complete five-interval table for each of the two azimuth subwedges, hence N is 6 or 8 with exact threshold c>max(sin phi,cos(phi+pi/4)). Haar spherical integration gives the two inverse sine terms. An independent sum of eight horizontal plus eight oblique edge-crossing probabilities yields an equal arccos formula. The asymptotics and equal-edge parameter follow by justified Taylor expansions and edge-length algebra. The included checker independently reconstructs the convex hull and intersections and passes numerical consistency tests. Boundary orientations have zero measure.

value.rationale: This is an exact complete probability law for a canonical semiregular polyhedron across all positive axial aspect ratios. Its support rigidity is not implied by parity alone or by the general edge-expectation formula, and the strict interpolation plus sharp quadratic thin and inverse-height tall asymptotics identify distinct geometric scaling regimes. It supplies an independently reproducible benchmark for random polyhedral sections without claiming any results for arbitrary antiprisms.
